notes.title: Update announcement on December 19th
notes.notes:
Update announcement on December 19th:
Dear players of "Heroic Academy":

We are very happy to announce that on December 19th, Academy of Heroes will receive a series of exciting updates and optimizations to further enhance your gaming experience. Here are highlights of the upcoming updates:

[h2]Added 26 new spiritual skills and new mechanisms:[/h2]We will introduce multiple new spiritual skills, each with a unique mechanism, bringing more changes and strategies to the battle situation. For example, "strong in body", "very brave" and "quick in eyes and hands", etc.
18 new pieces of equipment have been added, and the equipment is more diverse: a series of new pieces of equipment have been added, such as the "Blood-weeping Gun", "Earth-Shattering Ax" and "Soul-Draining Knife". Each piece of equipment will provide unique combat power enhancements for heroic spirits.
[h2] Adjustments to equipment wearing restrictions: [/h2] In order to give players more freedom and choices, we have removed the restrictions on most equipment.
[h2] Equipment refresh price optimization: [/h2] We have adjusted the price of equipment refresh to make it more reasonable.
[h2] Balance adjustment: [/h2] Balance adjustment for some heroic spirits, such as Guo Jia and Cao Zhi. The amount of damage taken, survival time and maximum number of summons of summons have been readjusted.
[h2]Spirit skills adjustment: [/h2] Specific skills have been fine-tuned. For example, "Putting Down the Butcher's Knife" now additionally reduces the healing effect received, while the increased damage value of "Bullying the Few" has been increased from 2% to 5%. .
[h2]BUG fix:[/h2] Fixed some issues that affected the smoothness of the game, including stuck NPC selection and stuck issues when viewing student portraits.

We are always committed to providing the best gaming experience and thank you for your continued support. We hope these updates will bring more fun and challenges to your gaming journey. Please look forward to the update on December 19th and continue to enjoy the strategic challenges and fun brought by "Heroic Academy"!

notes.title: "Early Update Arrival: Welcome to Endless Mode!
notes.notes:
"Early Update Arrival: Welcome to Endless Mode!

Hello everyone!

We are thrilled to announce that the major update for 'Spirit Academy,' initially scheduled for November 20th, has now been released ahead of schedule! With the relentless efforts and overtime work of our development team, we are excited to share this great news: the update is here early!

[h3]New Features:[/h3]
1.Endless Mode Attack: (Activation condition, completing a ten-year setting)
Now you can continue the game after the 10-year term, facing more challenges and peak competitions, while collecting various precious items, including student skins, portraits, equipment, and spirit techniques!
2.Room Position Exchange Function:
This update makes your management more intuitive, allowing you to place buildings at will, ideal for those with OCD.
3.Performance Optimization:
New animations will be displayed when acquiring spirits, enhancing the sense of immersion and ceremony!
4.Portrait Reward System:
By meeting specific conditions, you will unlock the students' portraits and also participate in the exciting collection system.
5.Tiered Technology Release:
Ease the difficulty of decision-making and master the essence of the tech tree with ease!

[h3]Optimizations and Adjustments:[/h3]
6. More BP Rules:
The AI intelligence system will undergo its first major upgrade, making battles more strategic and challenging.
7.New Ban Mechanism:
Ensures the fairness and competitiveness of the game, while allowing the AI to showcase impressive performances!
8.Recruitment Interface Optimization:
The allocation of technology points will now be more visually intuitive, making your decisions clearer!
9.New Auto-Backup Save Feature:
In case of save data loss, you can try to recover the last saved game content from the local automatic backup directory.
10.Various Other Optimizations

[h2]Note:[/h2]
1.When playing with old saves, there might be an issue where the computer doesn't have any equipment. You need to defeat the next level challenge for the AI to have equipment.
2.To activate Endless Mode, you need to complete the current peak competition.
3.To use Endless Mode with a completed old save: Load the previous save, and after completing the game once more, you can continue experiencing the game.
4.To use Endless Mode with an incomplete old save: At the end of the 10 years, the game will prompt a failure message, asking if you want to continue playing. If you choose to continue, you can keep playing until you complete the peak competition, after which Endless Mode will be unlocked.

Old saves can still continue to experience the game content and the new updates. However, we recommend starting a new save to experience the update.

Thank you for your continuous support of 'Spirit Academy.' We will always strive to present you with a more beautiful gaming world! If you like our work and our attitude, please give us a positive review, as it will be the driving force for our continued progress.

Gamer Community Group: 758282199"

notes.title: Major Update Preview - November 20th
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

[h3]New Additions:[/h3]
1.Endless Mode Unleashed: Now, even after the initial 10-year term, you can continue your journey, facing greater challenges and pinnacle events. Collect valuable items, including student skins, illustrations, equipment, and spirit techniques!
2.Room Position Swapping: Tailor your management experience to perfection by freely rearranging the layout of your academy. This update is designed with meticulous attention to detail.
3.Enhanced Visuals: Witness the acquisition of heroes with all-new animations, providing a greater sense of immersion and ceremony!
4.Illustration Reward System: Unlock student illustrations by meeting specific criteria, and participate in an exciting collectibles system.
5.Tiered Technology Unlocks: Say goodbye to decision paralysis. Now, you can master the essence of the tech tree with confidence and ease!

[h3]Optimizations and Adjustments:[/h3]
6.More Battle Point Rules: The AI intelligence system is receiving a major upgrade, bringing more strategic depth and challenge to battles.
7.Revamped Ban Mechanism: Ensure fairness and competitiveness in the game. Now, the AI can also showcase exceptional performance!
8.Recruitment Interface Optimization: Tech attribute allocation will now be presented in a more intuitive way, making your decisions clearer!
9.Several Other Optimizations

This update will inject more fun and innovation into "Academy of Heroes". We can't wait to share this exciting moment with you! Stay tuned!

Finally, we extend our heartfelt thanks for your ongoing support of "Academy of Heroes". We will continue to work hard to present you with an even better gaming world!

notes.title: October 31st Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
After seven days of intensive work, we have finally produced a major update that addresses many of the highly requested features and balance adjustments. Please feel free to leave comments or join our community group to get in touch with us for discussions and exchanges.

This update will bring about significant adjustments and improvements, affecting various aspects including progression pace.

Now, let's address something very important:
[h2]To fully experience the core changes in this new version, we recommend starting a "Start over" or "Begin again"[/h2]

Why do we recommend starting a "Fresh Game"? This is because the volume of new content in this update is quite substantial. While existing save files can still be played, you won't be able to fully experience the new content. Therefore, we recommend starting a "Fresh Game" to get the full experience.

Here are the highlights of this update:
1.All-New Mastery Refinement Feature: You can now personalize the mastery of your students to unlock their full potential!
2.Flexible Graduation System: Students will no longer be bound by fixed graduation periods. You can now choose to graduate at any time.
3.Increased Student Recruitment Opportunities: Each quarter, additional recruitment opportunities will be provided, giving you more chances to acquire your desired heroes!
4.About Inheritance: Inheritance will now only transfer the higher of the two corresponding attributes. This ratio can be enhanced through the tech tree!
5.Enhanced Student Training Efficiency: Students will now have higher training efficiency, making them more dynamic on their growth journey!
6.Brand New Auto-Training Feature: You can select specific students for designated hero training, and the system will automatically arrange training plans for you.
7.Introduction of "Invitational Match" Mode: The brand-new invitational match mode will offer opponents of various difficulties for you to freely spar with and hone your skills!
8.Comprehensive Tech Tree Upgrade: Multiple new technologies have been added, providing more opportunities to acquire four brand-new heroes and strengthen your team!
9.Hero Skill Enhancement Technology: The tech tree will incorporate technology to enhance hero skills, making your hero abilities even more formidable!
10.Life Functionality Upgrade: Students can now automatically handle activities like eating, sleeping, and playing, with the addition of an open prompt feature for a more convenient gaming experience.
11.Hero Adjustments: We have fine-tuned the size, range, and movement speed of certain heroes to enhance game balance.
12.Increased Rewards for Challenge Match Victories: Defeating the first-place challenger will now yield even more generous rewards, ensuring that your efforts are met with greater value!
Additionally, we have made the following hero skill adjustments:
1.Diaochan's Skill 1 (Minor Skill) has been given an extra damage effect.
2.The passive skill of Diaochan has been fixed to stack as intended, now accumulating layers.
3.Hua Tuo's Skill 2 (Ultimate) has had its range increased, reducing instances where it only healed the caster.
4.Zhao Yun's Skill 1 (Minor Skill) now includes a new area knockback effect.

[h3]Please be reminded:[/h3]
[h2]We strongly recommend starting a "Start over" or "Begin again"
We strongly recommend starting a "Start over" or "Begin again"
We strongly recommend starting a "Start over" or "Begin again"[/h2]

We will continue to devote ourselves fully, striving to present even more exciting content in future updates. Thank you all for your support of "Hero Academy," and let's work together to create an even better gaming world!

notes.title: October 24th Update: Out-of-Battle Gear Purchase + Numerous Enhancements
notes.notes:
October 24th Update:

Equipment System Upgrade: You can now buy and equip items outside of battles.

Swapping Equipment Positions: Players can now freely swap positions of their equipped items.

View Skills of Unacquired Heroes: You can now preview the skills and attributes of heroes you haven't acquired yet.

Optimization in Recruiting Student Heroes: When recruiting student heroes, both NPCs and players will no longer encounter unacquired heroes.

Quick Drag-and-Drop for Students: You can directly click and drag student avatars from the list.

Combat Exit Feature: Now, you can choose to exit during battles.

Enhanced Technology Page: A dedicated combat page has been added for easier navigation.

More Resolution Options: Game settings now offer a wider selection of resolution options.

Fix for Pre-Battle NPC Attribute Display: NPC attributes before battles will now display the correct level.

Fix for Post-Battle Black Screen Issue: The issue has been resolved, and a black screen will no longer appear after battles.

[Upcoming Update Plans:]

Practice Match Mode: This mode will introduce opponents of various difficulties for players to freely spar with.

Adjustment to Student Graduation System: Graduation for students will become a manual operation, no longer fixed to a four-year cycle. Additionally, recruitment will be adjusted to allow monthly enrollments.

Auto-Training Feature: Players will have the option to train specific students with designated heroes or opt for evenly distributed training, with the system automatically scheduling sessions.

Please note that the above-mentioned content is currently estimated to take approximately five working days. If everything progresses smoothly, there's a chance the update may be delivered ahead of schedule. Therefore, for all the fans of our product, please keep an eye on our announcements.

[Regarding the Features You're Eagerly Awaiting:]

Features such as "Spirit Refinement," "Skill Proficiency Boosting," "League Matches," "New Heroes," "New Skills," and "New Gameplay" are all in line and being worked on. We ask for your patience.

Moving forward, updates may not be released on a daily basis. This is because the changes are relatively substantial and require a longer development and testing period.

We will continue to strive to bring you more exciting gaming experiences!

Finally, we'd like to extend a special thank you for your support of our indie game. Let's work together to create an even better gaming world!

notes.title: October 23rd Update: Student Recruitment + Other Optimizations
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

First of all, thank you for your support and love for "Soul Academy".

In response to the feedback and suggestions we've received, we have prioritized and optimized the following content. We will continue to work on other issues and content, so please bear with us.

Update Content:

1. Student System Update:

Added the ability to lock refresh when recruiting students, giving you more flexibility in recruiting your desired students.
At the start of the game, you will receive 4 chances to refresh your initial student recruitment. If you're not satisfied with the students, you can start over.
2. Optimization of Hero Names:

In the game, we will use more names from the Three Kingdoms period to make the game closer to history. This will also facilitate discussions about lineup combinations.
3. Challenge Reward Adjustment:

Optimized and adjusted challenge rewards. Weaker and less necessary resources have been reduced or removed.
4. Attribute Effect Explanations:

When you hover over attributes such as Strength and Agility, specific effect explanations will be displayed, giving you a clearer understanding of their roles.
5. Equipment Selection Optimization:

In the pre-battle equipment selection interface, moving the mouse over the enemy's portrait will display skill and attribute tips, helping you make wiser equipment choices.
6. Spirit Technique Adjustments:

Some spirit techniques are now available to all professions, adding more diversity to the skills of heroes.
Opened Spirit Techniques: Key Figure, An Eye for an Eye, Resolute Will, Extreme Cold Constitution, Fighting Spirit Grows Stronger, Overpowering the Weak, Laying Down the Butcher's Knife, Going Down Together, Fatal Blow, Fighting Like a Cornered Beast, Seizing the Day, Unity of Attack and Defense, Night Raid.
7. Recommended Hero Refresh Fix:

Fixed the issue where the recommended hero frame did not refresh after obtaining a new hero, ensuring that you can promptly choose from the new heroes.
8. Win Streak Benefits Optimization:

Fixed the issue where consecutive wins might not yield Soul Coins. Additionally, benefits for 4-win streaks and 6-win streaks have been added.
9. Heritage Interface Optimization:

Fixed the issue where the mouse scroll wheel was ineffective in the heritage interface, improving interface usability.
10. Battle Achievement Correction:

Fixed the issue where achievements would pop up right at the beginning of battles, allowing you to enjoy the game more smoothly.
11. Difficulty Curve Adjustment:

Slightly adjusted the enemy strength curve, correcting the steep difficulty increase between "Famous Family" and "Legendary". This provides a more balanced challenge experience.
12. Battle Presentation:

Added a pause function during battles.
We've been working hard to optimize the game, but we know there are still many areas for improvement. If you find anything unsatisfactory or have suggestions for improvement, please feel free to contact us. Your feedback is our driving force for progress!

In the future, we will continue to strive to bring you more wonderful gaming experiences. Finally, a special thank you for your support of our indie game. Let's work together to create a better gaming world!

Game Player Exchange Group: 758282199
